verdict.rationale: A published uptime SLA and a public status page are fair questions for a SaaS work-management platform like monday.com, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no mention of an uptime SLA, availability commitment, or status page. The SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 compliance claims are a different capability and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a product manager, I know the vendor's published uptime SLA and can check real-time incident status via a public status page
